commands.command:
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '<RUN_DIR>/candidate-artifacts/U05/export' -File | Select-Object Name,Length
Get-Content -LiteralPath '<RUN_DIR>/candidate-artifacts/U05/export/resume.txt' -Raw
Get-Content -LiteralPath '<RUN_DIR>/candidate-artifacts/U05/export/resume.tex' -Raw
$exportChecks = Get-Content -LiteralPath '<RUN_DIR>/candidate-artifacts/U05/export/verification.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$exportChecks | Select-Object status,page_limit,checks | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
$hostChecks = Get-Content -LiteralPath '<RUN_DIR>/candidate-artifacts/U05/export/host-review.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$hostChecks | Select-Object review_type,independent_review,content_check,compilation,page_count,pdf_text_layer,compiler_warnings,visual_review | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
Test-Path -LiteralPath '<RUN_DIR>/candidate-artifacts/U05/export/resume.pdf'

checks.content: Ordinary same-context review of generated text and LaTeX against approved draft; name, dates, 3 sample stores, 8 weeks, 4 duplicate records confirmed; no unsupported additions found.
checks.compilation: UNAVAILABLE per actual verification record; not rerun at user request
